description: This Java source file implements an FO (Formatting Objects) renderer for form widgets within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods to render various form fields into FO XML, facilitating conversion of form models into FO documents for formatting and printing purposes.

classes.name: FoFormRenderer
classes.description: A specialized renderer class that converts form widget models into FO (Formatting Objects) XML for rendering in PDF or print media within the OFBiz framework.
